about: The free-label rule, stated once for both implementations: core/services/timetable_workspace.first_free_section_labels (Python; the server's next_free is its first label) and freeSectionLabels (static/js/page-timetable-workspace.js, fed a budget row's used_section_labels and remaining_sections). The next sections of a course take the first S-numbers no placed section holds: S1 and S3 placed, the next are S2 then S4, never S3 again. A label is compared trimmed and upper-cased; a label that is not S followed by a plain number (M1, A, S01) takes no S-number. A count that is not a whole number of at least 1 asks for none.

cases.name: the next free after a gap is the gap
a label used twice counts once
